title: Pinterest runs AI on fine-tuned Qwen for under 8% of closed-model costs
description:
Open-weight models are collapsing the cost floor for production AI. Pinterest disclosed that a fine-tuned Alibaba Qwen powers its features at under 8% of comparable closed-system pricing from Anthropic and OpenAI, and Rippling reported near-identical savings on a separate workload days earlier. Two companies in different industries arriving at the same conclusion signals a structural repricing, and it raises a pointed question for every firm still paying the full closed premium: what exactly does the other 92% buy? House committees are sending letters about reliance on Chinese-origin open models, but open weights, once released, are files. The diffusion has already happened.
